Work-slot deposit burning makes each task slot a paid commitment: an agent escrows 90 units per slot for 3 epochs before taking work.

The registry is a ridge workers must cross: slots rest on timber escrow, verdicts in a marble ledger. A VRF beacon draws 7 jurors per epoch; forgery burns the full deposit.

1,000 fake slots escrow 90,000 units, and a 30% detection rate burns 27,000 per round; a second offence freezes all deposits for 20 epochs.
